chief_complaint.text: Fever with unspecified duration and temperature

uncertainty_flags.reason: Minimal symptom reported with no timeline, temperature value, or severity (D4 compliance)

missing_information: Onset time and duration of fever
Associated chills, rash, or body pain

follow_up_questions.question: How many days have you had this fever, and did you measure your temperature?
Do you also have shivering, chills, headache, or vomiting?

urgency_reasons.reason: Vague symptom without onset or severity cannot be safely classified as LOW; requires followup

draft_triage_note: S: Patient states 'I have fever' with no additional history. O: No vitals recorded. A: Incomplete intake; unstratified febrile complaint. P: Follow-up questions prompted to clarify duration, severity, and associated red flags.
